entry.title: Ceremony of Eternal Bonding Reservation Restrictions
entry.summary: Ceremony of Eternal Bonding Reservation Restrictions
entry.content:
Maintenance may cause your reserved Ceremony of Eternal Bonding to be cancelled, requiring a reservation for another date.
We ask that you please consider the information below before making your Ceremony of Eternal Bonding reservation.

[Possible Maintenance]

・Sometime between Nov. 16, 2026 8:00 p.m. and Nov. 17, 2026 3:00 a.m. (PST)
・Sometime between Nov. 17, 2026 8:00 p.m. and Nov. 18, 2026 3:00 a.m. (PST)
・Sometime between Nov. 18, 2026 8:00 p.m. and Nov. 19, 2026 3:00 a.m. (PST)
・Sometime between Nov. 23, 2026 8:00 p.m. and Nov. 24, 2026 3:00 a.m. (PST)
・Sometime between Nov. 24, 2026 8:00 p.m. and Nov. 25, 2026 3:00 a.m. (PST)
・Sometime between Nov. 25, 2026 8:00 p.m. and Nov. 26, 2026 3:00 a.m. (PST)
・Sometime between Nov. 30, 2026 8:00 p.m. and Dec. 1, 2026 3:00 a.m. (PST)
・Sometime between Dec. 1, 2026 8:00 p.m. and Dec. 2, 2026 3:00 a.m. (PST)
・Sometime between Dec. 2, 2026 8:00 p.m. and Dec. 3, 2026 3:00 a.m. (PST)

*Subject to change.
*Emergency maintenance may occur outside of the times listed above.

[Confirmed Maintenance]

・None

*Please reschedule if your reserved Ceremony of Eternal Bonding overlaps with confirmed maintenance.

[Reservations Affected by Maintenance and Server Outages]

*As of February 2018, reservations scheduled to be held post maintenance or server outages will remain valid and no longer need to be rescheduled.

entry.title: Recovery from Japan Data Center Instanced Areas Technical Difficulties (Nov. 15)
entry.summary: Recovery from Japan Data Center Instanced Areas Technical Difficulties (Nov. 15)
entry.content:
We are pleased to announce that the technical difficulties with the JP Data Center Worlds listed below have been resolved.

We apologize for any inconvenience these may have caused and  thank you for your patience while the matter was being addressed.

[Date & Time]
Nov. 15, 2026 5:45 to 6:20 a.m. (PST)

[Details]
- Disconnections from some instanced content

[Cause]
Server Failure

[Affected Worlds]
All JP Data Center Worlds

entry.title: Mog Station Maintenance (Nov. 16)
entry.content:
The Mog Station maintenance will take place at the following time, during which users will be unable to use the services listed below.

・Upgrading from the Free Trial to the full version of the game
・Adding a new service account
・Adding expansion packages
・Adding other platforms

We apologize for any inconvenience this may cause, and we thank you for your understanding.

[Date & Time]
Nov. 16, 2026 11:00 p.m. to Nov. 17, 2026 12:00 a.m. (PST)
*Completion time is subject to change.

[Details]
- System maintenance

[Affected Service]
- Mog Station
